run_decoder_cli: run the decoder CLI to train a Poincare maps encoder or decoder model on a dataset
plot_embedding: create a 2D scatter plot of embedding coordinates with optional labels and color mapping
build_Encoder: build a PyTorch MLP encoder network with configurable batch normalization and hidden layer size
train_model: train an encoder or decoder model using Adam or Riemannian SGD in Poincare or Euclidean space
compute_poincare_distance: compute the pairwise Poincare distance matrix between points in the Poincare ball
